summary: Iteration 76 — verified all 4 signup onboarding fixes end-to-end. Backend pytest 5/5 green: (1) POST /api/signup/interview/start returned in ~0.4s (well under 2s) with the FIXED opener 'Hi Priya — tell me about Kaveri Threads — what do you do, and how do your day-to-day operations actually run?' index=1, max=4, session_id present; (2) POST /api/signup/interview/answer with realistic operational answer returned operational follow-ups ('where do orders most often get delayed — is it dye scheduling, loom availability, or something else?', 'who handles procurement — raw yarn, dyes — and how do they know when to reorder?') that do NOT re-ask what the company does; done=true after 3-4 answers; (3) POST /api/signup/interview/blueprint returned all required keys (departments, workflows, operational_tasks, approval_rules, welcome_line) with 5+ items each; (4) POST /api/signup/tts with en-IN returned valid base64 RIFF/WAVE audio (>1KB). Frontend E2E on /signup was completed end-to-end with fresh email dexfix+<ts>@test.com: basics → website skip → manual stage (verified NO signup-manual-description textarea, only industry+B2B chip+continue) → interview (header 'Dex · your COO interview', Q1 is fixed opener with founder+company+day-to-day operations, mic labeled 'Speak', operational Q2/Q3/Q4 from Claude) → build phase (Dex mascot rendered, progress bar visible, percentage crept 5%→91% then hit 100% only at reveal, 6 unique rotating wait lines observed) → reveal (build-counts + Enter DecisionOS button + personalized welcome_line referencing founder's actual answer 'close the QC-to-dispatch gap, stop packing lists from holding up shipments') → clicked Enter DecisionOS → navigated to /brief logged in. Total build phase wait was ~32s and percentage bar stayed strictly below 100 before the real completion.

critical_code_review_comments: signup.py interview_start correctly builds the fixed opener with no LLM call — verified <2s end-to-end. Founder first-name is taken from `founder_name.split()[0]` which handles missing names gracefully ('Tell me about ...').

INTERVIEW_SYSTEM prompt is well-tuned for operational follow-ups — the tested runs consistently produced questions about delays/handoffs/procurement rather than repeating 'what do you do'. Rules explicitly say 'The founder has ALREADY answered the opening question about what the company does'.

BuildReveal.js progress interpolation `Math.min(92, p + Math.max(0.4, (92 - p) * 0.028))` correctly asymptotes to 92% and only jumps to 100 on `setPct(100)` after register+blueprint resolve — verified in live run (max=91 pre-reveal, then 100 at reveal).
WebsiteIntel.js 'manual' stage no longer contains a description textarea — confirmed via absent data-testid signup-manual-description on the live DOM.
VoiceInterview.js presentQuestion fetches TTS FIRST then reveals caption + starts playback, eliminating the previous 2-3s caption-before-voice gap.

Recorder callback in VoiceInterview.js auto-sends via send(full) after STT — no extra tap. Typed answers still route through the Answer button. Mic recording UX (click Speak → click Stop to send) was not exercised end-to-end here (no synthetic audio driven), so `unverified: mic-record-auto-send-e2e` — the state machine reads correctly and backend STT contract is exercised by iteration 75.
